objective: Falsify or acquire a local completed two-check operation and its paid structured-floor interface before a memory claim.

inactive_witness.scope: A decisive channel-identity falsifier, not full channel certification.

required_acquisition: Physical instrument/process tomography including inactive and reference coherences
Full correction/reset duration with idle noise and neighboring spectators
Actual floor rate, bandwidth, implementation and cross-talk
Structured coefficients with M_ab/u_p bounds, validity period and out-of-catalog remainder
Shot correlations, leakage, reset excitation and bath memory
Overlap-trigger map and actual schedule statistics
Same-apparatus held-out comparator including calibration, echo/DD and periodic recovery
Energy, entropy export and routing ledgers

rate_gate.continuous_reservoir_exception: Direct-gate collision lemma does not constrain an independently justified simultaneous reservoir model.

pass_rule: Local map and noise/floor bounds meet preregistered apparatus tolerances, complete resource accounting, and matched comparison; global memory promotion additionally requires a usable fault criterion, 11-data-qubit apparatus-to-generator proof, locality and initialization/readout treatment.
reject_rules: Inactive witness fails the claimed coarse-map tolerance: classify the actual finer/other generator explicitly
Unbounded excluded noise coefficient or reset-induced bath correlation: reject structured compiler transfer
Queued/skipped/correlated triggers unaccounted in dynamics: reject exact independent-clock claim
Equally informed incumbent matches or wins: reject superiority claim
no_result_inference: This unexecuted contract is not a physical measurement or a capability.
